turns.sql:
WITH budget_stats AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id,
           SUM(spent) AS total_spent,
           SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
           CASE WHEN SUM(amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) END AS utilization
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
attendance_stats AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id,
           COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
expense_stats AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_expenses,
           SUM(CASE WHEN approved = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_expenses,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN approved = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) END AS approval_rate
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
),
attendance_threshold AS (
    SELECT attendance_count AS thresh
    FROM attendance_stats
    ORDER BY attendance_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
    OFFSET (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 0.75 AS INTEGER) FROM attendance_stats)
)
SELECT ev.event_id,
       ev.event_name,
       ev.event_date,
       ev.type,
       bs.utilization,
       asd.attendance_count,
       es.approval_rate
FROM event ev
JOIN budget_stats bs ON ev.event_id = bs.event_id
JOIN attendance_stats asd ON ev.event_id = asd.event_id
JOIN expense_stats es ON ev.event_id = es.event_id
JOIN attendance_threshold at ON asd.attendance_count >= at.thresh
WHERE bs.utilization >= 0.9
  AND es.approval_rate >= 0.95;
